Implemented the CLI simulator in [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py) with the interpreter/runtime in [output/rs274.py](/workspace/output/rs274.py). It accepts the required `--input` / `--output` flags plus tool tables, parameter files, block delete, carousel size, probe options, and trace output with the three sampling modes.

I verified representative cases for linear motion, arc motion, dwell, `G53`, `G81`, `G84`, `G92`, unit conversion, parameter-only lines, tool selection/change state, and spec-defined error output/exit behavior. One known limitation remains: cutter-radius-compensated arc moves currently error out instead of executing; straight cutter compensation is implemented, but compensated arc geometry is not fully finished yet.
